A REAL SUBSTITUTION IF the nodes land and no edge is ever proposed: the author asked to record that two people know each other and got two nodes and silence.

🔴 NEITHER READING IS AVAILABLE IF THE NODES DO NOT LAND. Check that first — two arms have already failed on that exact point, one because the scenario auto-approved and one because the approval named the wrong tool.
